shortDescription: Three z-levels (sky/surface/basement) in ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling/needs/work/storage come free from vanilla. Per-band biomes resolve through vanilla's own per-cell BiomeAt API; sky plateaus generate real vegetation, basements can be carved as Biomes! Caverns caves, and the camera can now pan freely with other levels clipped out of view.
body:
# As above, So below II — V2

> V1 is **DELETED** (156 files / 40,713 LOC). Current tree: **50 files / ~9,900 LOC**.

## Pitch
Three z-levels (sky / surface / basement) in ONE RimWorld `Map`, so the column behaves as one big map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky, (2) performance, (3) full vanilla parity.

---

# 1. THE ARCHITECTURE

One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount × Slot)`. Bands stack along **+z**, each a contiguous `CellIndices` range. `band = surfaceBand + level`; bottom-to-top = basement / surface / sky. An impassable, permanently-fogged **gutter** separates bands. Typical live layout: `200×768`, bandCount 3, bandHeight 200, slot 256, gutter 56, surfaceBand 1.

**`Slot` is rounded up to a multiple of 64.** Load-bearing: terrain shaders sample from WORLD POSITION, so a non-aligned offset makes identical terrain render with a different texture phase in the see-below view.

### The one insight everything rests on
`Region.Neighbors` is **topological, not spatial**. Two spatially distant regions sharing a `RegionLink` are adjacent as far as RimWorld is concerned. Both ends are `RegionType.Portal` (the stair subclasses `Building_Door`), and `Portal` fails `ShouldBeInTheSameRoom`, so the link **conducts connectivity without merging rooms/temperature/vacuum**. `Reachability.CanReach` is managed region-BFS, so it works unpatched — transitively fixing `ClosestThingReachable`, `RegionTraverser`, storage search and **every `WorkGiver_Scanner`**.

**Verified in play:** colonists cross bands for `HaulToContainer`, `HaulToCell`, `Ingest`, `Clean`, `BuildRoof`, `FinishFrame`, `LayDown`, `SocialRelax` — with no hauling code written.

### ⚠ Portal regions are ONE CELL — the multi-cell rule
`RegionTypeUtility.IsOneCellRegion(Portal)` is **true**: every door cell is its own Portal region. A 2×2 stairwell is **4 Portal regions per end**, and a wormhole must link **every cell pair**. Linking one pair leaves the rest of the footprint conducting nothing, and which cell a pawn walks into decides whether the stairs work — the classic "works sometimes" symptom. `AB2: band info` prints `links armed = N/M cells` with a `<-- PARTIAL` warning.

`AllowsMultipleRegionsPerDistrict(Portal)` is **false**, and vanilla's largest door is 2×1. Our 3×3 grand staircase = 9 Portal regions is **beyond anything vanilla ships**.

### The dividing line
| Class | Outcome |
|---|---|
| **Graph / logic** — reachability, storage, work scanning, hauling, needs, reservations | **FREE** |
| **Geometry / presentation** — LOS, range, targeting, path lines, ghosts, projectiles, labels, selection | **NOT free** |

Fix each geometry surface **at its own draw/compute site**. Never patch `Thing.DrawPos` globally — the see-below renderer prints below things at real positions then translates emitted vertices, so a pre-localized DrawPos double-shifts. (That was V1's `DrawPosOffsetPatcher`.)

### A third category: reachability-as-proxy
Some vanilla code uses `CanReach` to mean *"is this a sensible place"*. Confirmed in `WanderUtility.GetColonyWanderRoot` — idle pawns **commuted across bands to stand somewhere**. Fixed by clamping the root to the pawn's band. **Un-audited siblings:** joy/recreation spot choice, meditation focus, animal grazing/pen logic.

### Hard 1.6 constraints
- Pathfinder is **jobified**. A* neighbour expansion is **not patchable**. Custom traversal lives at `Pawn_PathFollower`.
- `PathFinder` has **no `FindPath`** — managed surface is `FindPathNow` + `PathFinderTick`.
- `PathUtility.BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on **unwalkable** cells. Sky bands are full of impassable `AB_OpenAir`, so diagonal-only links are a hazard.

### ⚠ Map components are UNSET during generation
`ABBandMap.Setup` runs in the `GenerateMap` postfix, so for the whole of map generation `bands.Banded` is **false** and every band helper answers as if the map were ordinary. Genstep-time band math must use `ABBandedGeneration.TryPendingSurfaceRect`. Standing trap for future genstep work.

---

# 2. PER-BAND BIOME — SOLVED

Logged for months as V2's *one genuine regression vs V1*. Closed.

**The problem.** V1 gave each level a real `BiomeDef` free (`pocketTileInfo.PrimaryBiome`, deep-scribed). V2 has one `Map`; `Map.Biome` is get-only, derived from the world tile.

**The discovery.** 1.6 ships a **per-cell biome API** for Odyssey mixed-biome maps: `map.BiomeAt(cell)` → `MixedBiomeMapComponent.GetBiomeAt(cell)`. Vanilla routes its own systems through it — `WildPlantSpawner` (9 sites: plant CHOICE, density, regrow days, cave-plant commonality), `WildAnimalSpawner` (5), `MapGenUtility` terrain (10). `Patch_MixedBiome_ABBandBiomeAt` prefixes that one choke point and answers from `ABBandEnv.BiomeOf`.

**Why this is NOT the rejected pattern.** What was ruled out was a contextual `map.Biome` *getter* driven by an ambient latch. `GetBiomeAt` takes the cell as a **parameter** — no ambient state, no ordering hazard.

**Scope guard:** only claims cells whose level is non-zero, so the surface keeps Odyssey's real mixed-biome grid.

**A patch was DELETED, not added.** `Patch_WildPlantSpawner_ABBandDensity` would now cause two bugs: (1) **double counting** — `GetBaseDesiredPlantsCountAt` is *fertility only*; vanilla applies density separately in `CalculateDesiredPlants`, so scaling both squares it; (2) its **basement hard-zero** blocked cavern regrowth. Plain rock still yields nothing anyway (zero fertility + `AB_Underground` `plantDensity 0`).

---

# 3. SKY VEGETATION

Two independent bugs, both fixed:
1. **`ABSkyBandGen` spawned zero plants** — terrain only, so summits generated bare. Added `SeedFlora` (staggered growth over classified plateau cells).
2. **`AB_OpenSky`'s `wildPlants` list was dead code** — `skyBiomeInherit = true` meant `BiomeOf` returned `map.Biome` and never read it.

**Design decision (user): sky biome is LOCKED to the surface biome.** No species filter — vanilla's per-cell `fertilityMin` gate already keeps lowland/water species off plateau soil, and open air / roof surfaces are never plateau cells. `AB_OpenSky` survives only as the opt-out path. Setting: `skyVegetationDensity` (0–2×).

---

# 4. BIOMES! CAVERNS BASEMENTS (re-added from V1)

`BiomesCavernsCompat` ported **verbatim**. `ABCavernGen` ports V1's carve genstep: worm-carved connected network, chambers, biome-authentic floors, support pillars, starting flora + fauna.

**Three V2 changes — NOT a copy-paste:**
1. **Band scoping.** V1 carved `CellRect.WholeMap` because the basement *was* the map.
2. **The biome.** No per-band `PrimaryBiome` → scribed `ABBandMap.basementBiome`. Without scribing, a reload silently reverts to rock.
3. **Foreign gensteps.** BC's scatterers pick cells **map-wide** and can't be scoped externally. `RunForeignGenStep` snapshots `listerThings.AllThings`, runs it, destroys strays outside the band.

**Earthen Depths** at a fair 40/30/30 **pending play test** (V1's rarity was a pocket-map temperature artifact). Settings render only when Biomes! Caverns is loaded.

---

# 5. VANISHING COLONISTS — ROOT-CAUSED AND FIXED

**The bug.** `ScenPart_PlayerPawnsArriveMethod` spawns the colony from **`GenerateIntoMap`**, driven by the `ScenParts` GenStep — *during* generation. Order is `FindPlayerStartSpot` (40) → `ScenParts` (41) → `Fog` (48). The old `FixPlayerStartSpot` ran in the `GenerateMap` **postfix**, on an explicit comment asserting "scenario pawns spawn AFTER generation" — false (`PostMapGenerate` only grants a thought). So: vanilla picked a spot anywhere in the **whole inflated map** → colonists dropped there → `Carve` ran `Destroy(DestroyMode.Vanish)` over them → the spot was moved long after they were gone.

**Why intermittent:** `CellFinderLoose.TryFindCentralCell` starts at the map centre, which for `surfaceBand 1` of 3 usually lands inside the surface band. Only a validator-driven wander into the gutter/another band deleted the colony — silently.

**Fix, two layers:**
- **Root cause** — `Patch_GenStep_FindPlayerStartSpot_ABSurfaceBand` clamps the spot into the surface band before anything consumes it (also fixes `GenStep_Fog`'s unfog root and `GenStep_Scatterer`'s fallback). Keeps a **24-cell margin** because `DropCellFinder` scatters pods well away from the requested centre.
- **Safety net** — `RescueStrandedColonists` runs before `Carve` and **moves** (never destroys) any player-faction pawn outside the surface band, with a `Log.Warning`. Covers pod scatter, gravship, modded ScenParts.

Gotcha hit while writing: the in-band offset must be modulo **`Slot`** (height + gutter), not band height.

---

# 6. CAMERA (2026-07-28)

### Bug: new/loaded colonies opened on the wrong level
`ABBandView` kept the viewed band in a **static `Dictionary<int,int>` keyed by `map.uniqueID`, never cleared**. `uniqueID` restarts at 0 for each new game, so every new or loaded colony inherited the band the *previous* colony was last viewed at — opening on the sky, or on black for an unopened band.

Fixed by moving it to **`ABBandMap.viewBand`** (per-map, **not scribed**). `FinalizeInit` — which runs for both a new colony and a loaded save — forces `viewBand = surfaceBand` **and explicitly moves the camera** into the surface band. The explicit move is load-bearing: with free panning there is no clamp to pull a restored camera position back, so the player would otherwise load into black space with no obvious way out.

### Feature: free camera panning
`Patch_CameraDriver_ABClipViewToBand` postfixes **`CameraDriver.CurrentViewRect`** and clips it to the current band. One patch hides everything, because vanilla funnels both halves of "what is on screen" through that property:
- `MapDrawer.ViewRect` is `CurrentViewRect.ExpandedBy(1)…`, and `DrawMapMesh` only calls `Section.DrawSection` for overlapping sections ⇒ terrain, buildings, plants, items outside the band stop drawing.
- `DynamicDrawManager.ComputeCulledThings` builds its Burst cull job from the same property ⇒ pawns and dynamic things are culled too.

Chosen over patching either draw site because `ThingCullDetails` is a **private nested struct** (a postfix cannot name it in its signature) and because it avoids a per-thing loop on a per-frame path. Only the returned value is modified, so vanilla's `lastViewRect` cache is not corrupted.

With `ABSettings.freeCameraPan` the band clamp is skipped entirely and vanilla's map-bounds clamping applies. **That is safe only because the view clip exists** — removing the clamp without it is exactly the run #7 regression (gutter and neighbouring level visible as a strip).

**Perf:** the clip memoizes per frame on `Time.frameCount`, mirroring vanilla's own `lastViewRectGetFrame` caching. `CurrentViewRect` is read several times a frame by vanilla plus three times by this mod, and resolving band bounds costs **two CWT probes** (`TryBandBounds` and `CurrentBand` each call `ABBands.CompOf`). Invalidated explicitly on `SetBand`/`JumpTo` so the clip can't lag a level switch.

---

# 7. MEASURED PERFORMANCE

| Stage | Total mod cost / 2000 frames |
|---|---|
| Baseline | **3,791 ms** (58 patches) |
| Overlay + re-arm gate + V1 delete | **740.9 ms** (22 patches) |
| Event re-arm + lighting bake | **122.4 ms** |
| Same build, 17 colonists | **215.8 ms** — fps 59.2, f95 16.69 ms |

1. `OverlayDrawer.DrawAllOverlays`: **1.406 → 0.0018 ms/frame**.
2. Wormhole re-arm: **0.339 ms/frame → 0, and no longer a patch.** Gating a hot method with a prefix recovered only 22% because the gate *added a second patch to a very hot method*. Now event-driven.
3. `SectionLayer_LightingOverlay` bake: **25 calls → 0.** Suppressing `Visible` stops the DRAW but not the BAKE.
4. **V1 deleted** — never inert, only idle.

Measured **not** a problem: `SectionLayer_ABBelowV2.Regenerate` ≈ **0.9 µs/call**.

### ⚠ Unmeasured
**`GetBiomeAt`** (per cell inside `WildPlantSpawner` scan loops; one-entry memo added) and **`CurrentViewRect`** (per-frame memo added). Both are the first things to profile next MDS run.

### Pathfinding — answered
| Scenario | Banded | Vanilla ctl | Ratio |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ai.pathfind` | **556.6 µs** | 944.6 µs | **0.59×** |
| `ai.reachability` | 1.152 µs | 0.393 µs | 2.9× |
| `world.regions` | 0.339 µs | 0.071 µs | 4.8× |

**No per-path regression.** The tax is reachability and region lookup, ~3× the regions/cells.

---

# 8. LESSONS THAT COST REAL TIME

1. **Classify by BEHAVIOUR, not directory.** `Section` instantiates every `SectionLayer` subclass reflectively — **deleting one is invisible to the compiler; a green build proves nothing.**
2. **A benchmark that surprises you is usually broken.** Sample outside the stopwatch; divide by effective iterations.
3. **Nested instrumentation inflates outer timings.**
4. **`PawnRenderer.GetBodyPos` discards `drawLoc`** for a humanlike in a bed.
5. **`RenderPawnAt` only self-heals when `!results.valid`.**
6. **A malformed `About.xml` silently DROPS a mod.**
7. **Never mutate a collection you're enumerating from a callback.**
8. **Diagnostics that omit the discriminating field cost cycles.**
9. **Look for a vanilla API before building a workaround.** The per-band biome regression stood as "V2's one genuine loss" while `map.BiomeAt(cell)` existed the whole time. Found by grepping the *consumer* (`WildPlantSpawner`), not the concept (`Map.Biome`). **Grep how vanilla CONSUMES a thing, not how it stores it.** The camera fix is the same lesson twice: clipping `CurrentViewRect` beat patching two separate draw sites.
10. **Distrust confident comments about ordering.** The vanishing-colonist bug survived because a comment stated pawns spawn after generation. **Verify ordering claims against the genstep list.**
11. **Static collections keyed by a game-scoped id leak across games.** `map.uniqueID` restarts at 0, so a never-cleared static dict silently carried state into the next colony. Per-map state belongs on the map component.
12. Misc: `menuHidden` doesn't exist on ThingDef · geysers are `destroyable=false` · `GenStep_Fog` fogs the whole map · `GenRadial` caps at ~79.8 · `MapDrawLayer.map` is private · emit ONE self-contained log message per event.

**PROCESS: measure, don't reason.**

---

# 9. DIAGNOSTICS
`AB2: band info` · `AB2: transit health` · `AB2: below pawn report` · `AB2: why is this pawn stuck` · **`ABStuckWatchdog`** · `AB2: toggle transit logging` · `AB2: below layer report` · `AB2: lighting report` · bisect toggles · `AB2: spike - build wormhole chamber` · **`AB2: biome report`** (per band, round-trips the REAL `map.BiomeAt()` against `BiomeOf()` and prints `<-- MISMATCH, patch NOT applied` if they disagree; plus plant/animal census and mean fertility).

# 10. OPEN WORK

### Untested
Biome work **verified good in play** (user confirmed). Still unrun: **cavern basements** (surface-band stalagmite leak is the key check), **colonist-spawn fix** (needs 3–4 generations; watch for `rescued N player pawn(s)`), **camera fixes** (load onto ground floor; free-pan hiding).

### Bugs
- **Transient stall near stairwells.** Watchdog verdict **BLOCKED**, self-resolves. It now reports `nextCell` occupant/door state — **read that line next.**
- **COMBAT — status was STALE in the old handoff.** Not untouched: **575 LOC / 3 files** implement shootline, body facing, gun-sprite aim, `ShotReport` distance localization, cross-band acquisition, projectile-origin translation. Correct status: **implemented, never verified in play.** (a) projectiles below still never drawn (`ABBelowDynamicDraw` iterates pawns only) — CONFIRMED; (b) "will still miss" likely obsolete since the origin patch moves the projectile into the target's band. **Untested interaction:** downward shots need below-draw to be visible, while **upward shots draw in the band above and the see-below renderer only looks down** — invisible even after fixing (a).

### Deferred
- **Elevator (3-level shaft).** Needs TWO counterparts on one building. (`AB_Elevator.png` exists, unreferenced.)
- **Transplant** — fixes the coastline caveat (**inland tiles for now**), save migration, true-lazy banding.
- Turret cross-band targeting · drafted move ghost · sky richness · Alpha Biomes carve types (V1 supported mycotic jungle / gelatinous superorganism / forsaken crags / tar pits; Alpha Biomes is installed).

### Perf backlog
Profile `GetBiomeAt` + `CurrentViewRect` · map gen ~3× slower · isolate `PathGridJob` rebuild · compat audit not started.

---

# 11. VERTICAL LINKS

| Def | Footprint | Cardinal approaches |
|---|---|---|
| `AB2_LadderDown/Up` | 1×1 | 4 |
| `AB2_StairsDown/Up` | 2×2 | 8 |
| `AB2_GrandStairsDown/Up` | 3×3 | 12 |

Transit is a **teleport** (`Carry`) — "grand" buys approaches, not speed. All inherit `AB2_LinkBase`, which overrides `blueprintClass` to `Blueprint_Build`; **without that override every link renders as a generic door while placing.** `ArriveRadius = LandingRadius + 1`, tied deliberately.

# 12. PUBLISHING STATE

**⚠ `PublishedFileId.txt` is present**, containing **`3773267907`** (2026-07-28 08:33). V1's id was `3767572810`, so "disconnected from the original" held — but **this is already a live Workshop item.**

That makes the description a **live store page making false claims**: `About.xml`'s `<description>` is still V1's and promises elevators, vertical conduit/water/duct/chem shafts, psycast cross-level targeting, caravans, Hospitality guest tours, trader airships, "zero recurring cost until you build a level". User-owned text — rewrite offered, not yet accepted.

Also stale: `About/known-issues.json` (V1's, 18 entries) · `ARCHITECTURE.md` · `docs/HELICOPTER_VIEW.md` · `docs/V2-HANDOFF.md` (predates sections 2–6).

## TESTING RULE
`isolated=true` always. Companions **`astryl.ModernDevSuite` + `astryl.ModernDevTools`**, plus **`BiomesTeam.BiomesCaverns`** (+ `BiomesTeam.CoreFramework`) for cavern work. Palette pins get culled for Playing-gated debug actions — use the Debug Actions menu. **Banding happens at generation ⇒ needs a NEW colony.** Map gen ~3× slower — expected. **Use inland tiles until transplant lands.** Transit logging and the stuck watchdog reset every launch.
